title: Refunds Netted Against a Marketplace Orders Guarantee Amount Claimed
content:
**Rule.** The refund offset of the amount claimed on a Marketplace Orders Northloop Guarantee claim is chosen as follows: where every unit ordered is claimed and item refunds already stand on the order, only those item refunds are deducted (tax refunds are netted in the tax part); where fewer units are claimed than were ordered, or the only refunds on the order are late-delivery shipping refunds, nothing is deducted, since those refunds concern other units or answer the late delivery and not the units claimed; otherwise every refund issued on the order is deducted.

## Basis questions and answers

**Q. The claim covers every unit ordered and the order carries item refunds as well as tax and shipping refunds. What is deducted?**
A. Only the item refunds.

**Q. The claim covers fewer units than were ordered and the order carries refunds of several components. What is deducted?**
A. Nothing.

**Q. The claim covers every unit ordered and the only refunds on the order are late-delivery shipping refunds?**
A. Nothing; those refunds answer the late delivery.

**Q. The claim covers every unit ordered, there is no item refund, and the order carries an original shipping refund?**
A. Every refund issued on the order, here the original shipping refund.

**Q. No refund at all stands on the order?**
A. Every refund issued on the order is deducted, which is nothing.

## Order of the tests

| Every unit ordered claimed | Item refunds on the order | Refunds on the order are only late-delivery shipping refunds | Deducted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | — | the item refunds |
| no | any | any | nothing |
| yes | no | yes | nothing |
| yes | no | no | every refund issued on the order |

### Hypothetical case

An order fully claimed, carrying an item refund of USD 30.00 and a tax refund of USD 2.40: the refund offset is USD 30.00.
